<!-- PRD §11: every PR must contain the fields below before review. -->

## Requirement ID
<!-- e.g. P01.01.2 -->

## Intent
<!-- one sentence: what business or technical outcome this delivers -->

## Files changed
<!-- exact list, or "see diff" if the diff is small and self-explanatory -->

## Screenshots / demo
<!-- required for anything user- or founder-visible -->

## Migration
<!-- schema/data migration included? rollback plan? -->

## Threat / security assessment
<!-- new data exposure, auth changes, agent tool access, etc. "None" is a valid answer but must be stated -->

## Tests
<!-- commands run + actual results. Never write "tested" without command, date, and result. -->

## Roll-forward / rollback plan
<!-- how to undo this safely if it breaks something -->

## Docs updated
<!-- README / ADR / runbook / API schema / founder guide — or "N/A" -->

## Cost changes
<!-- any new spend, even $0/month tier signups. "None" is valid but must be stated -->

## Human review
<!-- who reviewed, and confirmation this was not self-approved -->
